title: Design: Bill To list puts the current Bill To second, before A to Z
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer A, customer B and at least 5 other customers whose names sort before customer A.
  • Have a new open work order for this test for customer B with customer A picked as its Bill To.
  • Start on the work order page.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p3-17-after-change-bill-to.png, bt-p3-21-after-phone-change-bill-to.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps: 1. Click the Bill To field on the customer card.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "[customer B's name] (this customer)" is first.
  • Customer A (the current Bill To) is second, highlighted blue, ahead of the A to Z list.
  • The other customers follow A to Z.

Words in square brackets stand for the value they name, such as customer A's name exactly as it is saved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • S3-R3: “Typing searches every customer in the organization except Counter Sale, A to Z, showing the first 50 matches; the first option is always "[customer] (this customer)".”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "3 When the Bill To is blocked", pictures "Change Bill To" (This build), "Phone, Change Bill To" (This build).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p3-17-after-change-bill-to.png
  • bt-p3-21-after-phone-change-bill-to.png

The design's own words:

  • “The list: "Buda Truck Repair (this customer)" first, then the current Bill To "Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair" highlighted, then customers A to Z”

Difference: PRD S3-R3 orders the list A to Z after the (this customer) row (BT-D01, question 4).
